name: Common Reading Pipeline
description: A generic reading pipeline: recognizes requests to read stories, articles, reports, horoscopes and more aloud, and routes them to whichever installed provider skill can supply that content. Not tied to any single content type or source.

name: 365tomorrows Stories (provider)
description: Reads daily CC-licensed flash sci-fi from 365tomorrows.com aloud. Provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin - no standalone voice interface.

name: Andersen Tales (provider)
description: Hans Christian Andersen fairy tales provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. No standalone voice interface.
examples: Can you tell me a fairytale from hans christian andersen

name: Andrew Lang Tales (provider)
description: Andrew Lang's Fairy Books provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. No standalone voice interface.
examples: Tell me a fairy tale from the fairy books

name: arXiv Papers (provider)
description: Reads arXiv paper abstracts aloud. Provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin - no standalone voice interface.

name: Bechstein Tales (provider)
description: Ludwig Bechstein's German fairy tales provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. German only, no translation.
examples: Tell me a fairy tale from ludwig bechstein

name: Finished Booting Skill
description: The Finished Booting skill provides notifications when OpenVoiceOS has fully started and all core services are ready

name: Calculator
description: A basic calculator - add, subtract, multiply, divide, percentages, squares, square roots. Fully offline.

name: Colossal Cave Adventure
description: faithful port of the “Adventure” game to a OVOS Skill from the original 1977 FORTRAN code by Crowther and Woods.

name: Common Reading Example (template)
description: Template/example provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. Copy and adapt - not meant to be installed for its own content.

name: Confucius Quotes
description: Quotes from Confucius

name: Unit Converter
description: Local, offline unit conversion - no cloud dependency, no API key. Covers length, mass, temperature, time, speed, area, volume, angle, density, pressure, force, energy, power, torque, acceleration, concentration, computer, and flow.

name: Cosquin Tales (provider)
description: Emmanuel Cosquin's Lorraine folk tales provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. French only, no translation.
examples: Tell me a fairy tale from lorraine

name: Date and Time
description: Get the time, date, day of the week
examples: What time is it in Paris?

name: Today In History
description: Provides historical events for today or any other calendar day using information pulled from Wikipedia.
examples: Tell me about events in history on December 12th

name: Dictation skill
description: continuously transcribes user speech to text file while enabled

name: Fairy Tales
description: Tells fairy tales by Hans Christian Andersen and the Brothers Grimm.

name: Joan Fuster quotes
description: The Fuster quote of the day
examples: Tell me a quote from Joan Fuster.

name: Geography Practice
description: Geography practice - quizzes and teach-then-practice for capitals, continents, and country borders across 194 UN member states. Fully offline.
examples: quiz me on what you taught me

name: Geography
description: Geography facts - capitals, continents, borders, area, currency, and language for 194 UN member states. Fully offline.

name: Geometry Practice
description: Geometry practice - quizzes and teach-then-practice for glossary terms, formulas, and Pythagoras' theorem. Fully offline.
examples: quiz me on what you taught me

name: Geometry
description: Geometry knowledge - shape and term definitions, formulas, and applied calculations for rectangles, squares, triangles, circles, and the Pythagorean theorem. Fully offline.

name: GGWave Skill
description: Voice interface for ggwave plugin.

name: Grimm Tales (provider)
description: Brothers Grimm fairy tales provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. No standalone voice interface.
examples: Can you tell me a fairy tale from the brothers grimm

name: Hello World
description: Introductory Skill so that Skill Authors can see how an OVOS Skill is put together

name: Holidays
description: Public holidays, Easter, and calendar-date math. Fully offline, computed live via the holidays library.
examples: what day of the week is march 3rd

name: Horoscope Readings (provider)
description: Reads daily zodiac horoscopes aloud. Provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin - no standalone voice interface.
examples: Read me a horoscope about taurus

name: Jokes
description: Brighten your day with dad humor. Laughter is not guaranteed, but eye rolls are likely.
examples: Do you know any Chuck Norris jokes?

name: Intercom
description: LAN intercom - send a spoken message to a named OVOS device on the same local network. Fully offline, no internet needed. Speak-only, never executes commands on the receiving device.
examples: send a message to the bedroom

name: Device IP Address
description: Network connection information
examples: What network are you connected to?

name: ISS Tracker
description: Track the location of the ISS
examples: how many persons on board of the space station

name: Local Media
description: Local Media File Browser For Open Voice OS

name: Math Practice
description: Math practice for kids - counting, times table recitation, and interactive quizzes across addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentages. Fully offline.
examples: give me a full math quiz

name: Metronome
description: A metronome - set a tempo in BPM and get an audible click track with an accented downbeat. Fully deterministic and offline: generated click tones, not recordings.

name: Morse Code
description: Encodes text to Morse code, played as generated audible beeps. Fully offline, nothing recorded.

name: Movie Master
description: Find information about movies, actors, and production details. Easily find information about a movie with your voice.
examples: What are the highest rated movies out?

name: Naptime
description: Put the assistant to sleep when you don't want to be disturbed.

name: NATO Alphabet
description: Spells a word using the NATO/ICAO phonetic alphabet - Alfa, Bravo, Charlie. Fully offline, pure lookup table.

name: Network Scanner
description: Discovers devices on your own local network via mDNS/Bonjour plus a ping+ARP+MAC-vendor sweep. Fully offline, no root required.
examples: is my printer on the network

name: News Streams
description: News streams from around the globe.

name: Numbers
description: Facts about numbers

name: OVOS Blog (provider)
description: Reads the OpenVoiceOS blog aloud. Provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin - no standalone voice interface.
examples: Read newest post from the openvoiceos blog

name: Parrot
description: Turn OpenVoiceOS into a echoing parrot! Make OVOS repeat whatever you want.

name: Assistant's Background
description: Learn history and personality of the assistant. Ask about the 'birth' and parentage of the voice assistant and get a taste of the community who is fostering this open source artificial intelligence.

name: Rhythm Box
description: A simple drum-machine skill - loops a beat pattern (rock, four-on-the-floor) at a chosen tempo. Fully offline, generated drum sounds.

name: Sound Like
description: How does a cow sound? Bundled offline sounds (currently animals) for instant answers, with an optional freesound.org online fallback for anything else, filtered to CC0-licensed results.

name: Speedtest
description: runs an internet bandwidth test using speedtest.net

name: Tuning Fork
description: A reference-tone generator - give me an A plays 440Hz, play 300 hertz plays any frequency. Fully offline, generated tones, nothing recorded.

name: Voices of Tomorrow
description: Plays pre-recorded audio readings of 365tomorrows.com flash fiction stories, via OCP. Separate from ovos-skill-365tomorrows-stories, which reads the text aloud via TTS instead.

name: Volume Control
description: Control the volume of OVOS with verbal commands

name: Wallpaper Changer
description: Pictures from selected subreddits.

name: Weather
description: Get weather conditions, forecasts, expected precipitation and more! You can also ask for other cities around the world. Current conditions and weather forecasts come from OpenMeteo

name: White Noise
description: An ambient noise machine - white, pink, and brown noise for sleep or focus. Fully offline, all generated, nothing recorded.

name: WikiHow
description: How to do nearly everything.
examples: how do i get my dog to stop barking

name: Wikipedia
description: Query Wikipedia for answers to all your questions. Get just a summary, or ask for more to get in-depth information.

name: Wolfram Alpha
description: Use Wolfram Alpha for general knowledge questions.
examples: How many inches in a meter?

name: Wordnet Skill
description: Use Wordnet to answer dictionary-like questions.

name: World Tales
description: Classic fairy tales and folklore from around the world, starting with Andrew Lang's Fairy Books, sourced from Project Gutenberg.

name: skill-homeassistant
description: skill-homeassistant
examples: Change light bedside lamp to blue

name: skill-meal-plan
description: An OVOS voice skill for meal suggestions

name: skill-monster-scanner
description: An OVOS voice skill that scans for monsters under the bed
examples: Is the Boogeyman under the bed?

name: skill-musicassistant
description: skill-musicassistant
